description: Mareano referansestasjoner is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Havforskningsinstituttet. Datasettet viser referansestasjoner der MAREANO har samlet inn ett sett med visuelle og fysiske bunnprøver fra ulike redskap (f.eks. videorigg, bomtrål, slede, grabb, boxcorer, multicorer). Referansestasjonen er som regel forhåndsbestemt før toktene utfra tolkning av data fra mulitistråleekkolodd. Coverage: Havforskningsinstituttet. The publisher named on the listing is Havforskningsinstituttet. Its keywords include bunnprøverAntall, videoÅr, kommentar, bunndyp, boxcorerAntall, prøverTotalt. The listing shows 5 download or service links in TXT, XML, GDB, GML. The listing shows 2026-05-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
